caption: A soap bubble drifts past a bright window, and a tiny reflection of the window curves across the bubble's surface.

sa.check: A soap bubble drifts past a bright window.
A tiny reflection of the window curves across the bubble's surface.
The reflection moves across the bubble as it drifts.
The reflection vanishes when the bubble pops.

pc.expect: The window shows as a small curved highlight that moves across the bubble as it drifts.
pc.fail: The highlight stays fixed on the bubble while it drifts past the window; or it is missing beside a bright window; or it shows something not in the room.

pc.expect: The highlight is curved to the bubble and stays on its surface.
pc.fail: It is a flat rectangle; or it floats off the bubble; or it is larger than the bubble.

pc.expect: The bubble is a thin iridescent film that wobbles and pops into nothing.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or bounces like a ball; or pops into shards.

pc.expect: The bubble drifts and sinks slowly.
pc.fail: It rises steadily; or drops like a stone; or hangs still.
A second bubble appears from nowhere; or the popped bubble reappears; or the highlight becomes solid.

pc.expect: The window and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The window changes; or the room rearranges; or the bubble changes colour abruptly.
